text:
maya: Heads-up: scheduling a canary evacuation + traffic injection in eu-west3 TOMORROW 02:00-03:30 UTC. Goal is to validate graceful fallback, KV/prefix cache reseed, and cost delta when backfill kicks in. tagging infra oncall and perf folks.

jordan: Are we running a synthetic traffic injection or replay of real traffic?

maya: synthetic traffic that mirrors p95 token rates. small ramp: 100 -> 1000 concurrent reqs over 10m, hold 20m, scale down.

sandeep: If backfill spins up reserved GPUs do we expect preemptible churn? we should lock pool affinity for canary to avoid noisy neighbors.

maya: good call. we'll pin canary cohort to reserved-capacity pool (saturn-pool) and disable preemption for the window.

lee: Cost ask: how much extra GPU-hours and egress? i can run a quick forecast but need expected backfill ratio.

maya: estimating 12 extra GPU-hours if backfill occurrs fully, plus ~200GB egress for model pulls (quantized). Jordan / Lee, can you confirm with accounting?

jordan: i ran a quick sim against last week's shape — looks closer to 9–14 GPU-hours depending on cache hit. i'll post the spreadsheet.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary-evac-eu-west3-7995012345, scheduled 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Status: scheduled.

maya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-evac. key steps: 1) lift traffic threshold to 90% of normal for cohort, 2) trigger node cordon on cohort, 3) start traffic injector, 4) monitor prefix cache warmup and KV miss rate, 5) uncordon and verify no lingering evictions.

sandeep: small config snippet for the injector if useful:
```
redwood-inject --region eu-west3 --cohort saturn --ramp 100-1000 --hold 1200s --seed 42
```

lee: I'll run cost projection and drop in #finance in AM. Also propose we set a soft-threshold alert at +30% token latency p95 so we can stop early.

maya: agreed. also notify support: we'll send a short customer comms blurb saying low-risk canary test with expected <1% request reroute.

jordan: who wants to own post-mortem if cache reseed shows regressions? sandeep or maya?

sandeep: i can lead the post-mortem, will coordinate with perf for traces and with devex for example prompts to repro.

maya: awesome — thanks. final checklist: + runbook link in calendar invite, + ops rota notified, + cost estimate in finance thread. tagging @lee for finance. :thumbsup:

lee: acked. will post numbers by EOD.

maya: cool. rolling comms to customers at T-6h if nothing else. starting short smoke test tonight at 23:45 UTC on a single node to sanity-check the injector.

jordan: quick note — disable auto-quantize rollout during the window (we saw a model pull storm last time).

maya: done, disabling auto-quantize. thanks.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary-evac-eu-west3-7995012345 in 24 hours.

lee: thanks everyone. will follow up in finance thread and #eng-oncall.

maya: closing thread for now unless anyone has objections. :wave:
